title: Apple Cinnamon shows the power of seasonal scents
summary: Discover how Glad, Pine-Sol and Scentiva turned consumer insights into Apple Cinnamon products that bring seasonal fragrance to routines across the home.
body_markdown:
Glad first introduced its Apple Cinnamon-scented ForceFlex trash bags as a limited-edition seasonal offering last fall. Consumer response helped demonstrate the potential for seasonal scent innovation to bring something fresh and distinctive to an everyday household category.


Also looking to capture seasonal demand, the Clorox Cleaning team explored fragrance territories that could resonate with consumers during the fall season. Consumer testing resulted in Harvest Apple & Spice scent emerging as a top contender and informing Scentiva’s launch. Scentiva’s test results also shaped Pine-Sol’s innovation with Apple Cinnamon a clear winner in in their consumer testing. The result is a complementary lineup that gives consumers more ways to enjoy a familiar seasonal fragrance throughout the home.
